name: identity-session-device-security
objective: Close the Captain Identity session lifecycle, device binding, role/surface authorization, secure persistence, refresh concurrency and logout isolation.
truthOwner: Identity exclusively owns authentication/session identity and surface authorization; app-captain may consume but not replace it.

tasks.currentProblem: Token validity alone can be mistaken for app-captain authorization.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace login/session/refresh claims and backend enforcement so authenticated state requires sessionSurface app-captain, surfaceAccess app-captain and captain role; reject partner/client/field/operator surface tokens even when otherwise valid.
tasks.targetState: No actor enters or calls Captain-only paths without the exact Identity role/surface contract.
tasks.action: Trace Identity callers and claims, fix root causes, execute positive/negative authorization and remove any Captain-specific bypass.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend outage never preserves stale authorization.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused Identity integration only without restoring an authorization bypass.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused Captain Identity/session change after BB reconciliation.

tasks.objective: Close device, refresh, restart and logout lifecycle
tasks.currentProblem: Persisted sessions and concurrent refresh can create stale or duplicate authorization if rotation/revocation is not atomic.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise SecureStore restore, stable device fingerprint, concurrent refresh rotation, revoked/expired session, offline restart, logout and before-session-end hooks; ensure stale UI/data is cleared and downstream cleanup cannot preserve authorization.
tasks.targetState: One governed Captain session lifecycle remains correct across races, restart and logout.
tasks.action: Test races/restart/logout, fix root causes in Identity-owned code and Captain adapters, then re-run device/runtime proof.
mustNotChange: Do not let notification cleanup own logout.
Do not generate a second valid refresh session.
Do not expose persisted tokens outside secure storage.
Do not fabricate authenticated state offline.
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh race yields one legal rotation.
Restart restores only valid authorized state.
Logout clears Captain authorization and downstream endpoints.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused lifecycle changes while preserving Identity revocation/rotation authority.
tasks.commitBoundary: Focused session lifecycle change with concurrency evidence.
